name: zelari-code-vscode
description: Proof-of-concept VS Code extension that drives the existing zelari-code ACP headless front door: start a session, watch the tool-call stream, shut down clean.

commands.title: Zelari: Send Prompt to ACP Session

zelari.command.markdownDescription: Command on `PATH` used to start the agent (default `zelari-code`, i.e. `zelari-code acp`). Ignored when `#zelari.cliPath#` is set. On Windows a bare command needs a shell (the `.cmd` shim), so shell metacharacters are rejected up front instead of being handed to cmd.exe.

zelari.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed after `#zelari.command#` / `#zelari.cliPath#`. The default starts the ACP front door.

zelari.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `<checkout>/bin/zelari-code.js`. When set, the agent is started as `#zelari.nodePath# <cliPath> <args>` with **no shell** — the portable, Windows-safe form (recommended).

zelari.nodePath.markdownDescription: Node runtime used when `#zelari.cliPath#` is set (Node >= 20.17.0).
